title: Xyanyde
summary: A +1 mace that can reveal a target you miss and give attacks against it Advantage.

fields.Weapon profile: The item’s native template lists Martial. One-handed mace, 5 ft melee, Dippable. +1 to attacks. Hit for 1d6 + 1 Bludgeoning plus Strength.
fields.Xyanyde’s Fire: Once per Short Rest, missing with an attack can apply Faerie Fire for 2 turns. The illuminated target sheds dim light, cannot be Invisible, and grants Advantage to incoming attacks. This is a weapon passive with no listed save.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. Deal melee weapon damage. Constitution save against the higher of spell save DC or weapon-action DC +2 prevents Dazed for 2 turns. Dazed gives Disadvantage on Wisdom saves, removes Dexterity AC bonus and prevents spending Reactions. Help removes it.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Minthara in Act One. If imprisoned at Moonrise Towers in Act Two, the mace is in the Warden’s Office Evidence Chest.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
